title: Paired-cohort meta-analysis with dual RNA-seq replication of recurrent transcriptional alterations in hepatocellular carcinoma: reproducibility core
description: Public reproducibility-core release containing HCC analysis protocols, derived discovery and validation tables, figure source data, executable workflows, environment specifications and integrity checks.
